source.title: RC-505mkII Parameter Guide, Version 1.3 and later
source.extractionEngine: PyMuPDF table grid strategy=lines; parameter/value/marker cells bounded by table row cell rectangles, with proof-based virtual-row segmentation only when aligned parameter/value baselines and spanning printed rules establish the split
source.defaultExtraction: bold font spans intersecting only the geometric Value cell; absent bold span remains null
source.visualDefaultCues: Blue #00558F Value-cell spans remain candidates unless the exact printed-page/effect/parameter field is listed in root-confirmed review evidence; confirmed U+00B8 values preserve the glyph as defaultRaw without claiming a numeric default.
source.textNormalization: Whitespace inserted inside a printed decimal token by the PDF text layer is joined in rawValueText/defaultRaw; original PyMuPDF cell/span output is retained beside each normalized string.
source.explanationCellPolicy: Explanation cell content is not copied into this artifact
source.musicalGlyphPolicy: Raw extracted glyph text is preserved. The symbol meanings were visually reviewed against the SHA-pinned rendered source pages and per-cell geometry; the meanings are source metadata only and never synthesize runtime behavior.
source.musicalChoicePolicy: A mapped glyph labels only a symbol visibly present in the source cell. Dashes, endpoint notation and nearby numeric ranges do not establish the unprinted intermediate rhythmic choices; no eighth-note, dotted-note, triplet or other range contents are inferred.
source.structuredValuePolicy: Selected mixed values preserve separately printed list members, labeled range endpoints, musical-glyph runs and numeric ranges with cell evidence. No intermediate labels or rhythmic choices are synthesized, and these structures remain source metadata rather than DSP mappings.
source.limitation: Candidate parsing is conservative. Unresolved mixed domains, enum choices, and unreviewed defaults remain non-normative and must not be consumed by a runtime.

musicalGlyphMap.renderMethod: Official PDF pages rendered from the SHA-pinned source; notehead openness, stem and flag count inspected at enlarged scale; p.43 Scatter/Repeat and p.34 LPF enlarged glyph crops were retained as review evidence.
